result.title: OrthoLatentCAD: Orthographic Spatial Latents for Hand-Drawn CAD Program Generation
result.summary: Freehand orthographic drawings capture early design intent, yet recovering executable sketch--extrude CAD programs from raster front, right, and top views remains challenging: noisy, dimension-free 2D layouts must be reconciled into an ordered construction history. We introduce Hand2CAD, a benchmark of 215K ABC-derived synthetic orthographic-drawing--CAD program pairs and 1,000 real three-view sets drawn by CAD-trained participants. Recovering CAD programs from orthographic drawings requires both cross-view geometric reasoning and alignment between visual features and program representations. We propose OrthoLatentCAD to address these two challenges. It fuses local geometry with global context on canonical planes, exchanges evidence between paired plane lines indexed by the same shared-axis coordinate, and maps the spatial representation to ordered program latents through queries inherited from a frozen CAD autoencoder. Across the evaluated one- to three-view configurations, OrthoLatentCAD outperforms protocol-matched baselines in procedural accuracy, compiled geometry, and CAD-kernel validity while benefiting from additional views. Without real-data fine-tuning, it also outperforms the baselines on held-out real drawings. We will release the dataset, code, and evaluation scripts.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Hand2CAD：215K 合成与 1,000 组真人手绘三视图—CAD 程序基准，并构建 OrthoLatentCAD，在正投影平面上融合局部几何与全局上下文、按共享轴坐标跨视图交换证据，再通过冻结 CAD 自编码器的查询把空间表示映射为有序程序 latent。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨视图几何证据对齐与“视觉特征—程序 latent”对齐可供核查 LVR 中几何信息是否保留在内部状态、latent 如何与输出表示接口；但该方法是单次前向的图到程序生成，未涉及推理期状态迭代或动态计算，迁移价值需进一步判断。
